models.full_name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B (Apple Silicon across M4 Max / M5 Max / M3 Ultra / M5 Ultra)
models.why: A cross-chip Mac survey with each number's engine named: oMLX 0.6.4 with MTP depth 6 takes Qwen3.8-Flash-Next to 83 tok/s on an M4 Max 128GB and 224 tok/s aggregate at 4 streams, mlx-serve to 90 on an M5 Max (73.5 at 262k context), oMLX to 157.7 on an M5 Ultra 80-core, and TensorFold to 353 tok/s aggregate across 8 streams on the same Ultra.
